headline: Mahalaxmi Rubtech fined for XBRL reporting delay
hook: Minor regulatory penalty for filing delay
summary: Mahalaxmi Rubtech has paid a penalty of ₹23,600 to stock exchanges. The fine was levied due to a delay in submitting financial data in the mandatory XBRL format. This is a routine compliance matter regarding regulatory reporting standards.
why_it_matters: Minor compliance cost with no material impact on company financials.
